verdict.rationale: Cursor's Cloud Agents run in isolated VMs in the cloud, support parallel execution for hours/days, and can be launched via IDE, Slack, GitHub PR comments, or the Cloud Agents API, with artifacts (screenshots, videos, logs) attached to PRs for review — directly matching the story of delegating long-running tasks to an isolated cloud environment. This is backed by detailed first-party docs plus a live API probe confirming the endpoint is real and key-gated. missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party verification of actual background task completion quality, and community evidence is mostly about unrelated complaints rather than corroborating cloud-agent reliability.
